listing.name: Twisted Metal III — TwistedMetal1234Recomp (jcoker85)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream native TMIII profile, no independently verified complete TMIII route or Rev0 compatibility. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS1 USA TwistedMetalIII SCUS94249 Rev1 CHD or CUE/BIN; other game profiles not substitutes.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Manual shared Windows launcher/tools/generate.sh route, select tm3 and own Rev1 disc. Runtime uses OpenBIOS and original disc data.
